notes: Theoretical cosmology paper. It computes the QCD axion dark-matter abundance produced by axion strings during the scaling regime (with nonlinear effects near the QCD scale) using numerical field-theory simulations plus an analytic extrapolation. The headline result (Sec. 4, eqs. 6-7) is a lower bound on the QCD axion mass in the post-inflationary scenario: m_a >~ 0.5 meV, f_a <~ 1e10 GeV for N=1 (KSVZ), and m_a >~ 3.5 meV, f_a <~ 2e9 GeV for N=6 (DFSZ), from requiring the relic abundance not exceed observed DM. This is a theoretical relic-abundance prediction of the axion mass/decay-constant window, NOT an experimental or observational exclusion limit on any of the couplings in the task table (photon, electron, nucleon, EDM, etc.). No coupling-vs-mass exclusion curve is derived. Out of scope; is_new_limit false, is_projection false.
